cost: The tested metadata, 30-polygon query and point query worked without credentials or payment. Other access arrangements remain unconfirmed.
title: Ward boundaries
description: Retrieve New Haven's 30 ward polygons through the city's GIS API, or look up the ward containing a location. A City Hall example works; the layer's current legal boundary plan still needs confirmation.
access: City GIS JSON API; polygon and location queries tested
fields: Ward identifier; SmallInteger. All numbers 1–30 occurred once in the tested response.
Polygon coordinates returned with outSR=4326 (longitude, latitude).
Service record ID; present in metadata, not used as the ward identifier.
Ward label present in metadata; values not validated.
steps: Open the city ward-layer metadata and check the ward field and polygon geometry type. The service is named Wards_2022; its name and last edit date do not confirm the current legal boundary plan.
Retrieve the tested ward polygon query. It returned 30 records, one for each ward 1–30, with closed polygon rings in longitude/latitude using outSR=4326. Keep the ward value as the identifier.

Try the tested City Hall point query. The city's address layer returned 11 rows for 165 Church Street sharing one location. That point intersected Ward 7; an independent point-in-polygon calculation against the retrieved boundaries agreed.

Run the ward verification script with node scripts/verify-ward-boundaries.mjs from the repository root, or run the shared workflow with the wards option. It checks field availability, identifier coverage, polygon coordinates and the City Hall lookup; the all option includes it weekly.

Before presenting a lookup as a current official ward assignment, confirm the effective boundary plan with city GIS or the City Clerk. Use the separately documented Alders roster for representative names; this boundary check does not validate those names.
contact: gisadmin@newhavenct.gov is published in the city GIS gallery; responsibility for the current legal boundary plan needs confirmation.
limitations: The tested layer is Wards_2022 (BM_POL_Wards_2022). Its current legal boundary plan and effective date are not confirmed. A recent service edit timestamp does not establish boundary currency.

The tested City Hall point returned Ward 7 and agreed with the retrieved polygons. Other addresses, points on boundaries, ambiguous address matches, gaps and overlaps have not been validated. Ring and coordinate checks do not establish full topological correctness.

Representative and contact fields exist in metadata but were not retrieved or verified. Join to a separately checked roster using an explicit ward identifier; do not use this layer to fill a missing roster identifier by assumption.
Reuse terms and refresh responsibility remain unconfirmed. Successful API queries establish technical access within the stated scope, rather than legal permission or continued availability.
